name: PM-KISAN
description: Income support scheme for eligible farmer families.
benefits: Provides financial assistance to eligible farmer families.
eligibility: Eligible farmer families meeting the scheme requirements.
howToApply: Apply through the official PM-KISAN portal.

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
description: Government-funded health assurance scheme providing coverage for eligible families.
benefits: Provides cashless health coverage for eligible medical treatments at empanelled hospitals.
eligibility: Families and individuals identified as eligible under the applicable PM-JAY eligibility criteria.
howToApply: Check eligibility and obtain an Ayushman Card through an authorised government or empanelled facility.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana
description: Housing scheme aimed at helping eligible households obtain affordable and adequate housing.
benefits: Provides housing assistance or financial support to eligible beneficiaries under applicable PMAY components.
eligibility: Eligible households meeting the income, housing and other criteria prescribed under the applicable PMAY component.
howToApply: Apply through the applicable PMAY government portal or designated local authority.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana
description: Scheme supporting access to clean cooking fuel for eligible households.
benefits: Provides eligible beneficiaries with support for obtaining an LPG connection and related assistance under applicable provisions.
eligibility: Eligible adult women from qualifying households meeting the scheme requirements.
howToApply: Apply through an authorised LPG distributor or the official PMUY application process.

name: National Scholarship Scheme
description: Scholarship support provided to eligible students through government scholarship programmes.
benefits: Provides financial assistance to eligible students to support their education.
eligibility: Students meeting the eligibility, academic and income requirements of the applicable scholarship.
howToApply: Register and apply through the National Scholarship Portal.

name: Post Matric Scholarship
description: Scholarship assistance for eligible students pursuing education after secondary school.
benefits: Provides financial assistance for eligible students to support post-matric education.
eligibility: Eligible Maharashtra students meeting the applicable category, income, academic and course requirements.
howToApply: Apply online through the Maharashtra MahaDBT portal.

name: Maharashtra Student Scholarship
description: Educational financial assistance for eligible students in Maharashtra.
benefits: Provides scholarship or educational assistance to eligible students.
eligibility: Students satisfying the eligibility requirements of the applicable Maharashtra scholarship programme.
howToApply: Apply through the relevant Maharashtra government scholarship portal or department.

name: Maharashtra Farmer Support Scheme
description: State-level agricultural support intended to provide assistance to eligible farmers in Maharashtra.
benefits: Provides eligible farmers with financial or agricultural assistance under the applicable programme.
eligibility: Farmers meeting the eligibility requirements prescribed by the Maharashtra government for the applicable scheme.
howToApply: Apply through the relevant Maharashtra Agriculture Department or government portal.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
description: Crop insurance scheme designed to protect farmers against specified crop losses and risks.
benefits: Provides insurance coverage and financial compensation for eligible crop losses caused by covered risks.
eligibility: Farmers growing notified crops in notified areas and meeting the applicable scheme requirements.
howToApply: Apply through authorised banks, insurance channels, government portals or other designated channels within the applicable crop-season deadline.

name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana
description: Government programme aimed at improving irrigation access and water-use efficiency in agriculture.
benefits: Supports irrigation infrastructure, water conservation and efficient use of water for agriculture.
eligibility: Eligibility varies according to the specific component and implementing programme.
howToApply: Farmers and eligible entities can approach the relevant state agriculture or irrigation department for applicable components.

name: Kisan Credit Card Scheme
description: Agricultural credit facility designed to provide farmers with timely access to short-term credit.
benefits: Provides access to credit for crop production and eligible agricultural and allied activities.
eligibility: Farmers, tenant farmers, sharecroppers and other eligible agricultural borrowers subject to lending-bank criteria.
howToApply: Apply through participating banks, cooperative banks, regional rural banks or other eligible financial institutions.

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
description: Agricultural programme that provides farmers with information about soil health and nutrient requirements.
benefits: Helps farmers understand soil nutrient status and make informed decisions about fertiliser use.
eligibility: Farmers and agricultural landholders whose soil can be tested under the government programme.
howToApply: Contact the local agriculture department or designated soil testing facility for soil testing and Soil Health Card services.

name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana
description: Programme supporting organic farming and sustainable agricultural practices.
benefits: Supports groups of farmers adopting organic farming practices and helps promote sustainable agriculture.
eligibility: Farmer groups and eligible agricultural communities participating in approved organic farming programmes.
howToApply: Approach the state agriculture department or designated implementing agency for participation.

name: National Agriculture Market (e-NAM)
description: Pan-India electronic agricultural trading platform connecting agricultural markets.
benefits: Provides farmers with access to wider markets, transparent price discovery and electronic trading facilities.
eligibility: Farmers and other eligible agricultural market participants using participating markets.
howToApply: Register through the e-NAM platform or with a participating Agricultural Produce Market Committee.

name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund
description: Financing facility supporting investment in post-harvest and agricultural infrastructure.
benefits: Provides access to financing and eligible interest support for approved agriculture infrastructure projects.
eligibility: Eligible farmers, farmer producer organisations, cooperatives, agri-entrepreneurs and other qualifying entities.
howToApply: Apply through the Agriculture Infrastructure Fund online portal and participating financial institutions.

name: National Mission for Sustainable Agriculture
description: Programme promoting sustainable and climate-resilient agricultural practices.
benefits: Supports practices and technologies intended to improve resource efficiency, soil health and agricultural sustainability.
eligibility: Farmers and eligible implementing entities under the applicable programme components.
howToApply: Contact the state agriculture department or designated implementing agency for applicable components.

name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization
description: Government programme promoting access to agricultural machinery and farm mechanization.
benefits: Provides support for eligible agricultural machinery, equipment and mechanization activities.
eligibility: Eligible farmers, farmer groups, cooperatives and other approved agricultural entities subject to applicable guidelines.
howToApply: Apply through the state agriculture department or designated government agricultural mechanization portal.

name: National Livestock Mission
description: Government programme supporting entrepreneurship, productivity and development in the livestock sector.
benefits: Provides support for eligible livestock-related activities, entrepreneurship and infrastructure development.
eligibility: Eligible individuals, entrepreneurs, farmer groups, organisations and other entities depending on the programme component.
howToApply: Apply through the National Livestock Mission portal or the relevant state animal husbandry department.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana
description: Pension scheme providing social security support to eligible small and marginal farmers.
benefits: Provides a monthly pension after attaining the prescribed age, subject to scheme conditions.
eligibility: Eligible small and marginal farmers within the prescribed age and landholding criteria.
howToApply: Register through Common Service Centres or other authorised channels using the required documents.

name: Formation and Promotion of 10,000 Farmer Producer Organizations
description: Government initiative supporting the formation and development of Farmer Producer Organisations.
benefits: Supports farmer collectivisation, access to markets, inputs, technology, finance and improved bargaining power.
eligibility: Eligible groups of farmers and Farmer Producer Organisations formed under the applicable scheme guidelines.
howToApply: Farmers can approach implementing agencies, Farmer Producer Organisations or relevant agriculture departments for participation.

name: National Cooperative Development Corporation Schemes
description: Financial and development programmes supporting eligible cooperative societies and cooperative-sector activities.
benefits: Provides financial assistance and support for eligible cooperative development, infrastructure and related activities.
eligibility: Eligible cooperative societies and organisations meeting NCDC programme requirements.
howToApply: Eligible cooperatives can approach NCDC or the relevant state cooperative department for applicable assistance.

name: Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS) Computerization
description: Government initiative to computerize and strengthen Primary Agricultural Credit Societies.
benefits: Improves PACS efficiency, transparency, accounting, service delivery and access to digital cooperative services.
eligibility: Eligible Primary Agricultural Credit Societies and cooperative institutions covered under the government programme.
howToApply: Implementation is generally coordinated through the cooperative department and relevant cooperative institutions.

name: Maharashtra Namo Shetkari MahaSanman Nidhi Yojana
description: Maharashtra government farmer-support programme providing additional financial assistance to eligible farmers.
benefits: Provides financial assistance to eligible farmers in addition to applicable central farmer-support benefits.
eligibility: Eligible farmers in Maharashtra who satisfy the scheme's prescribed requirements.
howToApply: Eligible beneficiaries are generally identified and processed through government agricultural and PM-KISAN-related systems.

name: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Shetkari Karj Mitra Yojana
description: Maharashtra government agricultural credit and farmer-support initiative.
benefits: Provides eligible farmers with assistance related to agricultural credit and financial support under applicable provisions.
eligibility: Farmers meeting the eligibility requirements prescribed by the Maharashtra government and implementing institutions.
howToApply: Approach the relevant Maharashtra government agriculture or cooperative department and participating financial institution.

name: Maharashtra Agricultural Competitiveness Project
description: Agricultural development initiative aimed at improving farmer access to markets, technology and competitive agricultural value chains.
benefits: Supports improvements in agricultural marketing, productivity, value addition and market access for participating farmers.
eligibility: Eligible farmers, farmer groups and agricultural organisations covered by the applicable programme components.
howToApply: Contact the Maharashtra Agriculture Department or relevant implementing agency for applicable programmes and opportunities.
